A.name: MAST_DEFAULT
A.construction: Exact base-case prompt only, with no wrapper or added instruction.

B.name: MAST_THOROUGH
B.construction: Exact pinned MAST thorough prompt followed by the exact base-case prompt.

C.name: UNIVERSAL_ONLY
C.construction: Exact complete frozen Universal Instructions 20.5.15 followed by the exact base-case prompt.

D.name: UNIVERSAL_PLUS_HRP
D.construction: Exact frozen Universal 20.5.15 plus HRP 20.5.24 condition used in calibration, followed by the exact base-case prompt.

generationRules.invalidMechanicalRunHandling: Retain the invalid receipt in the deviation log, exclude it from analysis, and rerun the identical family-arm-trial in a fresh clean conversation before evaluation or unblinding.

blindingAndEvaluation.judgeUnit: One opaque response at a time with its exact case, pinned rubric, and case-specific guidance.

analysisFreeze.familyArmScore: Arithmetic mean of the three adjudicated per-response F1_weighted values for that family and arm.

exploratoryContinuationGate.purpose: Exploratory decision on whether to authorize a separately specified perturbation or official-scoring stage; not a confirmatory efficacy threshold.
integrityPrerequisites: all exact-input and exact-output hashes present
no unresolved model, reasoning-mode, tool, source, or blinding deviation
two complete blind evaluations per response
no family exclusion, replacement, or denominator shrinkage

safetyCriterion.comparison: Arm D severe-commission response rate <= Arm B severe-commission response rate

exploratoryContinuationGate.passRule: PASS only if every integrity prerequisite, every primary-signal criterion, and the safety criterion are satisfied.
exploratoryContinuationGate.failRule: FAIL if all integrity prerequisites are satisfied but any primary-signal criterion or the safety criterion fails.
exploratoryContinuationGate.indeterminateRule: INDETERMINATE if any integrity prerequisite fails or required adjudication remains unresolved.

nextBoundedSlice.name: EIGHT_FAMILY_FOUR_ARM_BASE_CASE_GENERATION
nextBoundedSlice.scope: Generate base-case responses only for Derm001, Endo002, GI004, Heme010, ID008, Nephro005, Neuro007, and Pulm005.
nextBoundedSlice.execution: For each untouched family, generate three independent fresh-conversation trials under each of arms A, B, C, and D, with tools disabled and exact provenance captured.
nextBoundedSlice.stopBoundary: Do not execute perturbations, inspect untouched-family rubrics or guidance for scientific interpretation, tune any protocol, apply the continuation gate, or make any efficacy claim until all 96 base responses and their provenance receipts are frozen.
nextBoundedSlice.afterGeneration: Perform the frozen condition-blind two-judge evaluation and required adjudication, compute family-level D-minus-B results, and apply the already-frozen exploratory continuation gate.
